IIM Bangalore Ranks 21st Globally in Financial Times Masters in Management Rankings

The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Bangalore's Post Graduate Programme (PGP) has achieved the 21st position globally in the Financial Times Masters in Management (MiM) 2026 rankings. This ranking also secures IIM Bangalore's status as the top-ranked institution in India for this program. The Financial Times rankings highlight that five Indian business schools have secured spots within the global top 50. The PGP program at IIM Bangalore has climbed seven places to reach its current global standing.
